The TOTO C776CEFG#01 is a Drake elongated toilet bowl in Universal Height, finished in Cotton White (#01) and sold as the bowl only. It installs on a 12" rough-in and uses TOTO's TORNADO FLUSH, a rimless design with two nozzles, together with the CEFIONTECT glaze. The vitreous china bowl measures 28-3/8" long and 14" wide, with a 16-1/8" rim height. The flush volume is set by the tank; the bowl is listed at 1.28 GPF and as ADA compliant.

Key Features

  • Elongated bowl, 28-3/8" long by 14" wide
  • Universal Height: 16-1/8" rim height
  • TORNADO FLUSH: rimless, hole-free bowl with dual nozzles that swirl water around the bowl
  • CEFIONTECT glaze that keeps waste from sticking to the ceramic
  • 12" rough-in
  • Vitreous china in Cotton White (color code #01)
  • ADA compliant; can meet EPA WaterSense, CEC and CALGreen requirements when paired with the correct tank

What Is Included

  • Included: Drake toilet bowl C776CEFG#01
  • Not included: tank. A compatible Drake tank is required and is sold separately.
  • Not included: toilet seat. A TOTO SoftClose seat or a WASHLET bidet seat is sold separately.
  • Not included: wax ring, toilet mounting bolts and water supply line

Before You Order

  • Tank: this bowl needs a compatible Drake tank. TOTO's Drake 1.28 GPF two-piece spec sheets list tank ST776EA with the C776 TORNADO FLUSH elongated bowls.
  • Rough-in: 12". The 10" rough-in bowl is a different model, C776CEFG.10.
  • Height: Universal Height (16-1/8" rim). The standard-height Drake bowl is C776CEG.
  • WASHLET+: this is not the WASHLET+ ready bowl; that version is C776CEFGT40.
  • Seat: order an elongated seat.
  • Color: #01 is Cotton White. Order the tank and seat in the same color code.

The TOTO ST776EA#01 is a Drake toilet tank rated 1.28 GPF, finished in Cotton White (#01) and sold as the tank and cover only. It is made for Drake bowls with the TORNADO FLUSH system and has a 3" flush valve and a chrome left-hand trip lever. The vitreous china tank is 17-3/16" wide, 7-3/8" deep and 14" high. It is auto flush compatible when paired with the correct WASHLET+ bidet seat, and it meets EPA WaterSense, CEC and CALGreen requirements.

Key Features

  • 1.28 gallons per flush
  • 3" flush valve for the Drake TORNADO FLUSH system
  • Chrome-plated left-hand trip lever
  • Auto flush option when paired with the correct WASHLET+ bidet seat
  • Meets EPA WaterSense, CEC and CALGreen requirements
  • Vitreous china in Cotton White (color code #01); 17-3/16" wide, 7-3/8" deep, 14" high

What Is Included

  • Included: Drake tank and cover ST776EA#01
  • Included: tank to bowl gasket, tank to bowl hardware and toilet bolt caps
  • Not included: bowl. A compatible Drake bowl is required and is sold separately.
  • Not included: toilet seat or WASHLET bidet seat
  • Not included: wax ring, toilet mounting bolts and water supply line

Before You Order

  • Bowl: TOTO spec sheets list this tank with the Drake TORNADO FLUSH bowls C776CEG, C776CEGT40 and C776CEFGT40 (elongated) and C775CEFG (round). Confirm your bowl model before ordering.
  • Trip lever: left-hand. The right-hand trip lever tank is ST776ER.
  • Flush volume: 1.28 GPF. Check that this meets your local code.
  • Auto flush: needs a compatible WASHLET+ bidet seat, sold separately.
  • Color: #01 is Cotton White. Order the bowl and seat in the same color code.

The TOTO SW4736AT40#01 is the S7A WASHLET+ electronic bidet seat for elongated bowls, in Cotton White (#01) with a contemporary lid that opens and closes automatically. It has warm, aerated front and rear spray from an instantaneous water heater, a heated seat, a warm air dryer and an automatic air deodorizer.   • Lid: this is the contemporary lid. The S7A with the classic lid is SW4734AT40.
